sourcedFrom: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 (2020)
cleanIntro: The SR22 strips with a rotating takedown lever and the slide coming off the FRONT of the barrel — not straight back like most pistols.

steps.title: Safety on, magazine out
steps.action: Point the pistol in a safe direction and put the safety lever fully down so the red is covered, then press either magazine latch and withdraw the magazine.
steps.prose: The SR22 has latches on both sides. Either works.
steps.quote: Keep pistol pointed in a safe direction and place safety lever in the "safe" position (lever fully down and red area covered).
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 1, p.24
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Lock it open and look
steps.action: Pull the slide to the rear and lock it open by pressing upward on the slide stop, then check the chamber is empty.
steps.prose: Ruger puts an exclamation mark on this one.
steps.quote: Visually check to be sure the chamber is empty!
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 2, p.24

steps.title: Close the slide under control
steps.action: Grip the rear of the slide with thumb and index finger, pull it rearward and release it.
steps.prose: Controlled, not dropped — this is a small pistol with a light slide.
steps.quote: Close the slide by gripping the rear of the slide with the thumb and index finger, pulling rearward and releasing the slide.
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 3, p.24

steps.title: Takedown lever fully down
steps.action: Rotate the takedown lever down until it is fully dropped.
steps.prose: Fully. A partly rotated lever will not release the slide and will feel like the gun is stuck.
steps.quote: Rotate the takedown lever down until it is fully dropped.
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 4, p.24

steps.title: Slide back and up
steps.action: Grasp the rearward portion of the slide, pull it all the way to the rear, and lift upward.
steps.prose: Back then up — the lift is what clears the rails.
steps.quote: Grasp the rearward portion of the slide, pull it all the way to the rear, and lift upward.
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 5, p.25

steps.title: Slide forward off the barrel
steps.action: Holding the rear of the slide up, move the slide forward and off the front end of the barrel.
steps.prose: This is the SR22’s oddity: the slide leaves over the muzzle, not off the back.
steps.quote: Holding the rear of the slide upward, move the slide forward and remove it off the front end of the barrel.
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 6, p.25

steps.title: Guide rod and recoil spring out
steps.action: Remove the guide rod and recoil spring from the slide.
steps.caution: Spring under tension. Keep it pointed away from your face.
steps.quote: Remove the guide rod and recoil spring from the slide.
steps.cite: Ruger SR22 Manual Safety Model Pistol Instruction Manual — PM521 — Disassembly, step 7, p.25

deepAbsentReason: PM521 documents the field strip only — takedown lever, slide, guide rod and recoil spring. No disassembly past that point is published, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent patch, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Rimfire fouling is waxy and builds fast — clean the chamber as carefully as the bore

cleaning.name: SLIDE & BARREL
tasks: Scrub the breech face and around the extractor
Wipe the barrel exterior and the slide rails
One drop of oil on each rail, spread thin

reassembly: Return the guide rod and recoil spring to the slide.
Slide the assembly back over the barrel from the front, seat it on the rails, and rotate the takedown lever fully up.
fncheck: With the magazine out and the chamber confirmed empty, check the safety blocks the trigger and the slide runs freely, pointed in a safe direction.
